name: Haihara Reiji
source:
"How many times do you plan to make me say 'whatever'?"

A senpai of Kazuya and his friends and the current president of the literature club. He's a man who seems to have been blessed with two gifts: good looks and intelligence.

He generally has a cool and dry attitude, and gives off an unapproachable air, which makes him an outsider at school, for better or worse.

[Translated from [url=https://nenaico.com/samaao/chara04.html]official website[/url]]
